nom: Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Overnight Recovery Face Cream + Mask

avis.texte: It's a luxurious, gentle, very hydrating night treatment with a sensible peptide/adenosine formula. 0
I like to use this before bed. I don't need to apply too much to wake up to moisturized skin. The effect is supple skin. It helps minimize wrinkles too
I like that this product is fragrance free and gentle on the skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very nice facial product. This helps with my dry skin and I wake up feeling more hydrated than usual. Great product to add to my night time routine.
This is great if you need a very deep overnight moisturizer. I use Moisture Surge Mask and this is 10x more moisturizing.

I've been using Clinique for a while, I love so many of their products already . I recently got the night cream and I am obsessed . My skin tends to get very dry and I love how this cream feels at night. Waking up my face looks moisturized and that's what I need.

I've used Clinique for the past 35+ years (that I can remember). When I first got the Smart Clinical Repair, I was really happy with it, especially since I have incredibly sensitive skin. I heard reviews saying the only way to really reduce wrinkles is to use a retinol cream. Several skin burns later, and no "better" visible results, I'm back to my tried-and-true, which works remarkably well, with no fear of looking like I've been in the sun for 12 hours. I came in to get a new container and the price has gone up dramatically. I think I'll need to wait for a sale.
Very nice. Smooth and silky. Keeps my skin from being so dry in the mornings and moisturizes all night.

Hello, I'm reviewing the overnight recovery cream + mask. This cream is my favorite purchase from Clinique! I use this Every Night and the next morning my face feels soft, and my lines are not as noticeable. The hydration is unimaginable! My face is Very Sensitive and prone to redness that's why I like this product because I haven't had a bad reaction from night one and it works! . Also, you don't need to coat your face with the cream it's best to use less as not to waste the cream. It's a lighter creamy consistency so its easy to spread or pat into your face. Give it a try it's been a great find for my skin .. good skin products we all want and I don't normally do reviews but this was a must for me. I have been using this cream since it first became available ... several months so I've had plenty of time to know that it's working for me. I hope this review helps you. Thanks

I really wanted to love this product and wake up in the morning with glowing skin and reduced lines. I'm in my late 20s and have fine lines in my forehead, so I thought this cream would be ideal. Unfortunately, it doesn't reduce the lines at all and I just wake up with an oily forehead. I've been using it every night for months, as advised by Clinique's beauty consultants, and nothing has changed. Since I was convinced to keep using the product, the return period has passed and now there's nothing to do. Definitely a waste of money.

Since I have been using this overnight mask my face feels so much better, and I notice the difference in my skin being less stressed and brighter and healthier looking. It is not heavy, greasy, or tight on my skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I found this overnight cream was alright. The feeling of it on my face when you first put it on is very sticky. That does go away after a while but not at first. Packaging is great though.

I tried a sample of this night cream for 3 nights. I absolutely love the visible results so this will be my next big purchase. I couldn't believe how soft and plumped up my skin looked. It took off 10 years!

I added this product to my current regimen of the Smart serum and the Smart eye cream, both product which I love. i added it in the fall to help with weather related dryness. it did hydrate my skin, but I started to break out with small pimples in the nose & chin area, highly unusual for me. I contacted customer service twice about returning the product, but got the run around and so fare have not been able to get a refund.
I absolutely love this stuff. I'm a retinol user and this stuff is amazing. Really calms everything down. I use an oil with it as well. Nice job on this one.
I like this product! The cream is not too thick and is very hydrating. Great for night
I received this sample as a gift with purchase and it is amazing. A little goes a long way!
I am 60 years old and I regularly use this mask at night. It seems to me that my skin has become smoother and fine wrinkles have disappeared.
This product isn't safe to use - caused full hives all over my neck which has never happened to me before.

avis.titre: Caused my skin to flake and peel
avis.texte: I've been using Clinique products almost exclusively for 35 years, and this is the first product I've ever had a complaint about. After using this moisturizer for about a month, my face started to flake and peel excessively. I discontinued use, and the peeling stopped after a few days. I resumed use and the peeling immediately started again. Such an expensive disappointment!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product! The cream is not too thick and is very hydrating. It doesn't have a scent. I like how it is in a jar so I can see how much is left and I can use all of the product. I haven't seen a huge difference long term yet tho. I also think it's overpriced.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Left my face feeling greasy and I didn't like the scent. This product was a no for me. Used it one time, so can't say it works or not, I threw it in the trash.

I especially like the lightweight texture and feel of this moisturizer. However, that's where my praise ends. This moisturizer causes my skin to develop small pustules on various areas of my face. It also leaves my face feeling somewhat irritated. I have tried all 3 night time options within this range and I much prefer the wrinkle correcting cream with and without sunscreen over this formulation.

I'm not complaining about the SMART skincare line at all. It has transformed my skin to looking fabulous. It's the way the products were sent to me. My box from CLINIQUE was NOT SEALED - NO PACKING tape at all. The box had a lid that was easily opened and closed. I found that alarming. My husband retrieved the box from the front porch and he even thought that was unacceptable to have skincare in a box with a lid that was easily opened and closed. All three products were in the box. But, how do I know that the products weren't tampered with????? Unacceptable! CLINIQUE make sure all your products shipped are properly sealed for delivery.

I got this as a sample with one of my purchases and have used it here and there, alternating nights with moisture surge when my rosacea is flared up. I noticed that EVERY SINGLE TIME I apply this at night before bed I wake up to beautifully refreshed, calm, smooth skin that has a healthy glow instead of the usual red, blotchy, tired and uneven looking skin I would normally see in the morning. The first couple times, I thought it was a fluke and I just happened to get such a great night's sleep that it showed in my skin because that seems too quick to see such amazing results, but it has happened consistently and I'm now out of my sample so this is one of the products I must now have on hand, always. Ordering right now!

avis.titre: My Mom's Skin Feels Softer and Calmer
avis.texte: I got this for my mom, and she absolutely loves it. She says her skin feels much softer in the morning and looks more refreshed.

avis.titre: Went bad early and didn't deliver results
avis.texte: Not impressed. This cream didn't deliver any consistent visual skin results at all. Also, after about 4 months of use, it started developing a bad smell and started irritating my face. I might have gotten a bad jar, but I definitely wouldn't repurchase, especially at this price tag. Though Clinique still dominates my skincare, I'll pass on this one in the future.

I struggle to find deep moisturizer for overnight that is fragrance-free. I have a sensitivity to products with retinol and vitamin C, so this is my go to deep moisturizer. I also love that it's fragrance free. I always wake up with a glow when I use this.

This feels good on my skin but I haven't used it long enough to see effects. It is quite sticky and takes a while to soak in at night. One suggestion is to include instructions. I really have no idea at which point in my skin care routine to apply this product.
I love this cream and can never do without it. Finally, I found something that feels moisturizing. Do not stop making this cream!

Love this cream! It hydrates my skin overnight and I feel fresh and rejuvenated in the morning. The scent is light & it's an easy product to use in my skincare routine. Not super greasy & feels great. Best to use in winter or when traveling!

I use Clinique products almost exclusively. I have skin allergies and Clinique products don't irritate my skin. As an older woman I really like using products that can aid me with the usual issues. I like to think I don't have as many wrinkles using these products. I am very happy with Clinique.
I love clinique and sadly they are a bit lacking in the night cream department. I h ave mature, dry skin and this cream is amazing!

This overnight recovery cream and mask went on so smoothly and left visible results as I continued to use the product. The packaging is also so nice in the beautiful purple jar- it makes you feel good about putting it on.

Love this overnight repair cream! I'd been using my regular daytime moisturizer overnight, but it wasn't doing the job, especially in dry Colorado winter. This cream felt much richer and more luxurious on my skin, and felt like it really provided intense hydration that lasted into the morning.

Got 2 little packages to samplecthis after purchasing something from tge brand. The mask is sticky to the touch, like you letting glue dry on your face. The smell reminds me of olay just lighter scented. It did quickt hydrate my face over night!

The recovery cream was packaged in a beautiful purple container and was easy to use. The smell isn't bad and I like the smoothness of how it goes on. My skin absorbed all of the product and looked smoother over time.

I love the gentle scent of this moisturizer, and the texture of it is amazing. It is thick and super moisturizing, but absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any sticky residue. It feels so luxurious - would highly recommend!

I use this as a neck cream and really enjoyed it! It is not too heavy and never get sticky, it doesn't really have a scent and is easy to apply. As you can see the jars, a beautiful addition to my counter! ￼
Ideal dor delicate or damaged skin barriers! Lightweight, soothing, gentle, and perfect for any skin type. Will continue to purchase

I recently added the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair™ Overnight Recovery Cream + Mask to my nighttime skincare routine, and I am impressed by the results. It is a fantastic product if you're looking for an overnight cream that really works on hydration, firmness, and visible repair. The price point is on the higher side, but the results make it worthwhile. Highly recommend for anyone seeking a solid overnight recovery cream that feels and looks luxurious!

This goes on so nice and leaves my face feeling fresh and smooth. I really love the subtle scent, highly fragrant face creams are not for me. My skin is glowing and all my dry patches have gone back to normal. I have combination skin and this doesn't leave me feeling greasy. It's so light.

I love the scent of this product and the feel on my skin as well. It is very moisturizing and doesn't leave a greasy residue on my skin. The only thing I didn't absolutely love is that I couldn't see the ingredients on the actual jar. I will be using this product routinely and see how effective it is. I have not necessarily seen actual changes to my skin from this product- however, I use multiple products. Hopefully I will update once I know more!
Blown away by this product! Soothes my redness, fades scaring and spots, and even my pores are smaller. Have tried so many products, and can't believe the results I'm seeing with this. LOVE!!

Travelled a lot this summer and noticed my skin has not been happy about it. Have been looking for something that is moisturizing and also helps soothe/calm my skin down and this cream is great! Especially love that it is comfortable to apply and doesn't feel very heavy sitting on my skin.

Loooooved this product! There is no scent so no irritation from that (or anything else). It's smooth and creamy, feels luxury. It melts into the skin leaving this glassy finish. My skin is so much softer for it and boy did I need it in this arizona sun!

The jar is beautiful. The cream is so moisturizing and makes your skin so smooth and soft. It has a pleasant scent, nothing too strong. I noticed a visual improvement to my skin after a few days. I received this product in exchange for a review.

Packaging has a nice weight to it and feels high quality. There is a light scent, reminiscent of a lot of higher end skincare, but nothing too unique or overpowering. It feels very nice going onto the skin and despite this being an overnight cream, it doesn't feel heavy at all. The only 'overnight' aspect it seems to have is a bit of a slow initial absorption, so you'll want to put this on at least 10 minutes before getting in bed. I do feel like it has made significant improvements to the texture of my skin. In the morning, my face feels bouncy and soft. Some residue will rinse off in the morning, but it doesn't feel necessary to do so. This could easily be a daytime moisturizer in the winter, as long as you give it plenty of time to soak in before moving on with your routine.

I have acne prone to skin and I am very picky on what I put on my face. This overnight mask is amazing, I can't rave enough. Clinique always comes with clean ingredients and glides on your skin effortlessly, leaving your skin glowing and moisturized in the morning.
The jar is beautiful! I love the consistency of the mask and its light scent. It leaves my skin super soft after I've used it and it's replaced my evening skin cream!
Personally didn't like the scent. Gave skin a slight burning sensation. Didn't seem to want to absorb into my skin.
I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. The cream is thick. It doesn't smell like perfume. I love how it goes on my skin. I would recommend to all my friends

This mask and cream combo is perfect for dry skin. It's not sticky or heavy feeling at all and by the morning, my skin feels smooth and moisturized. I love that it's unscented and gentle. I have pretty sensitive skin and there's no burning like I get with other products. Love this cream!

I received this product free to try from Influenster. I absolutely love the Clinique Smart Clinical Overnight Recovery Cream & Mask. It is fragrance-free and has a rich and creamy texture that deeply moisturizes. I have sensitive skin, and this product did not irritate my skin at all.

I received this from Influenster to try and review. I am happy to report—this is an excellent product. Full disclosure—I've tried other products in this line, and have been pleasantly impressed by them all. So, I tried this mask, and it hydrated, plumped, made my skin look rejuvenated. This was evident from one use. A little goes a long way, so it should last a while too.

This is a good product. It kept my skin smooth and moisturized. It absorbed easily into my skin and I awoke with my face feeling soft and supple. The scent was pleasant as well. I would recommend it. Thanks Influenster for allowing me to try it.

I received this product from Influenster to try and review. I absolutely love it! It makes my face feel hydrated without any greasy residue. My skin is sensitive but this doesn't cause any breakouts to occur. The scent is soft and pleasant.
I had to buy me another. It makes my skin super soft and it doesn't have a scent. I put it on when I go to sleep and I wake up with soft skin and I love it! Definitely recommend

My skin felt great the next morning after using this product. It doesn't have a scent so it's great for sensitive skin. It was absorbed very well into my skin and I think it's a great product for people with dry skin.

It's very hydrating. There is not really a scent to it. The packaging looks nice. It's very smooth but not heavy. I would probably only continue to use it once or twice a week. I was offered this product for free to try through influenster.

I traditionally reserve moisturizer for the AM. This product is amazing and complements any daytime routine. The texture is light yet you can feel it working. Over the weeks, I've noticed positive results with daily use. It's been a great product to travel with as well. So glad I added this to my routine.

I definitely noticed a difference in the softness and texture of my facial skin !! I could feel it working instantly the first time I used it !! This I now a definite addition to my night time routine
Light product, easy to apply, Adorable packaging, and feels great upon application. I have noticed much difference since using it but consistency is key!

Used this product continuously for two weeks before reviewing. I love the texture and ease of use of this product. A little goes a long way. I have been able to see firmer skin around my eyes (crows feet) and my chin. There is no off putting scent or anything. Just smooth and easy to use.

Packaging, color, design, smell and excellent texture. The best anti-aging cream, with unique ingredients and results. You can see the difference with continued use. It is easy to apply, leaves no residue and your skin looks and feels beautiful and healthy. My opinion is based on my personal experience.

avis.titre: If you have skin, this its for you!#
avis.texte: This is a miracle cream in a jar in my opinion. I noticed an immediate difference in my skin. That's saying something! Softer, smoother, tighter, just healthier in general. It really has no irritating smell and is not at all greasy or oily. Absorbs just beautifully. My sensitive skin loves it. My 1st impression was the georgous purple jar. Incredible packaging. Life long consumer from here on out! Let me tell you, if you have skin, this its for you!!!

very rich and hydrating. no smell which I like. it moisturizes my skin to baby soft. I already see improvement in the fine lines. I will use this as a daily night cream and hopefully see improvements in the weeks to come ￼

I revieved this product in exchange for my honest review. When I opened the jar I noticed the scent is very nice. I applied the cream after washing my face. The cream went on smooth and the texture was creamy and rich. The cream absorbed well in my skin. The next morning my skin looked nice. I feel the cream was effective as a mouisterizer. I've used the cream two weeks and it seems to have a smoothing effect on my facial skin.

I received my Clinque overnight mask for my honest opinion. I was quite weary about a product that doesn't have any indication of acting or reacting to skin but only just realized this product is quick absorbing and instantly hydrates my skin and eases my itchy face. The next morning my face is not puffy or sunken in, it plumps my face and lifts my double chin.

I received this item complimentary in exchange for my honest review. It has a very subtle scent. Nothing strong, but it says it's unscented. It seems very hydrating but left my face a little greasy the next day. I think if you really struggle with dry skin it would be great.

I love that this cream is non scented for overnight use. It's thick so you do not need to use very much. I noticed the fine lines on my face looking much smaller. Not gone but I can tell the difference. I will continue to keep using.

I received the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair for free through Influenster, and I'm really pleased with the results. After using it consistently for over two weeks, I can confidently say it's a standout product. Unlike other overnight creams I've tried, which often feel thick and heavy on the skin, this one absorbs beautifully. It sinks in effortlessly, leaving no residue, almost as if it hasn't been applied at all. By morning, my skin feels incredibly smooth, and the softness lasts for days. The scent is very mild and not overpowering, which I appreciate. The packaging is also impressive—despite accidentally dropping the jar, it remained intact without any damage. Overall, I'm really enjoying this product and will definitely purchase it once my current jar runs out.

What I like about this product is how effective it is at making my skin fell smooth and beautiful in the morning after applying it at night. I like how nice the packaging is and that it has a lot of product so you get a lot for your money.
I love that cream. I have very sensitive skin and the average cream let me get pimpels and is itching. Not this one, i am really impressed. It smells good and my wrinkles are getting tighter.

The Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Overnight Recovery Cream + Mask is a great addition to any nighttime skincare routine. I received a complimentary product for review purposes courtesy of Influenster. I have been using the Clinique Smart Clinical Overnight Recovery Cream + Mask for several weeks and I am impressed with the results! After using the Overnight Cream - I noticed a visible difference in the fine lines on my forehead, neck and eye area. I loved the smooth, creamy texture of the cream/mask - smooth application, hydrating and moisturizing benefits and the beautifully colored jar. Loving the results so far!
I loved this cream on my face, it feels so soft, it keeps me hydrated, my face looks phenomenal, it has a rich smell, the packaging is the ideal size. I receive this product free by complimentary
Love that this product doesn't have a strong scent. This product goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly. My face felt smoother and moisturized from the first day of using.

Clinique Smart Clinical Repair was simple to use and felt really creamy. I was nervous with it being a glass container and having a very curious and active kid in the house, but there was no problems with that. You can use it as a mask or cream. I wished there were a bit more instructions with it. Overall, it was a great product and left my face feeling very nice.

This cream is a luxurious addition to any nighttime skincare routine, promising deep hydration and powerful anti-aging benefits in one. The texture is rich and velvety, offering a sense of indulgence as it melts into the skin. I love that this cream served a dual function as both a cream and a mask. You can apply it as a generous layer to serve as an overnight mask or use it more sparingly as a nightly moisturizer. I've noticed a significant improvement in the overall texture and tone of my skin. Fine lines around my eyes and mouth have softened, and my skin looks noticeably firmer and more youthful. The formula is also gentle enough for those with sensitive skin. I didn't experience any irritation, which can be a concern with more potent anti-aging products.

Hydration and good absorption are important to me in an overnight mask, and the Clinique Overnight Recovery Cream met my needs. It leaves my skin feeling soft and radiant in the morning. It has a soothing effect on my skin, and is a luxurious addition to my bedtime routine.

Love that this product feels hydrating! Love the texture and I can feel the moisture. Packaging is nice and simple too. I need to try it for a few more days and nights to see the effects but so far my skin is feeling hydrated! I received this product for free

avis.titre: Noticeable difference in a short time!
avis.texte: I have been using Clinique's Smart Clinical Repair Overnight Recovery Cream & Mask for approximately 1 month. The jar itself is actually very nice. If you drop it, it will not crack or bust the lid off. I drop items often, so that is important to me. The cream is rich and melts into your skin quickly. The scent is light and is pleasant. I've definitely noticed an improvement in my skin, but the most surprising benefit is that it helped firm up the skin on my neck! I have tried multiple creams that claim to restore firmness on the neck, this is the first cream that has done just that and done it so effortlessly! This cream is worth it just for that benefit alone. I have been using the cream nightly, but if I am not going anywhere for the day, I also use it in the morning as well. I am definitely a fan of this Clinique cream!

The packaging is durable and sleek. I love that its easy to throw in a bag when on the go. The product is silky and not heavy on the skin. It absorbs well and does not leave a greasy or sticky residue. I don't find it has much of a scent. A little goes a long way with this product, I even apply it down my neck. It's too soon to tell if the product has made any changes to my skin but so far no reactions or blimishes.

avis.titre: Skin feels much smoother after use
avis.texte: Received the product for review. Product was very smooth and went on very nice woth a very pleasant scent. My skin feels smoother in the morning after use the night before. Definately would include in nighttime skincare routine.

avis.titre: Another great product from Clinique. but similar to others
avis.texte: I was gifted the Smart Clinical Repair Overnight Recovery Cream + Mask from Clinique in exchange for my honest opinion. I am a huge fan of Clinique products and have been using them since I was a teen. I am getting to the point where my skin needs some extra love as it starts to shown signs of aging.. I enjoy using overnight products because of the way they leave my skin feeling renewed. This cream has the same effect. It is very thick making it so that a little goes a long way I didn't think it was overly greasy. All Clinique products are fragrance free but. I still think it has a subtle scent that is very distinctive of the brand. It blends in nicely and leaves skin smooth. It provides a lot of hydration. Overall, I think it is a decent product and would recommend it. That being said, I think it is similar to others on the market. However, I am a loyal Clinique customer and trust their products so I would most likely choose this over any other brand .

Let's start with the packaging-the purple jar is beautiful, the packaging is nothing too extraordinary. However, the product is mind blowing! The cream has a thick texture, however it spreads easily and gets easily absorbed in the skin. It has a light fragrance and is not greasy at all. I have dry skin which feels parched at times but I wake up with healthy, hydrated skin since I have started using this cream. I love it and would definitely recommend the same.

I received a Smart Clinical Repair Overnight Recovery Cream + Mask from Clinique and Influenster for my review. The cream has a light texture and almost no scent. I used it in the end of my night routine and I can say that the cream takes 15-20 minutes for complete absorption, don't go to bed right away, give it some time to absorb. I prefer to apply little bit thicker layer, because it works better. In the morning my face looks refreshed and ready for the day. I didn't experience any irritation even having very sensitive skin. I think it's a good cream for every day usage.

The face cream by Clinique has made my skin feel soft and brighter after using it for a week. The texture is very creamy and absorbs really well, my skin doesn't feel greasy after applying it. The scent is very light, just enough to feel Luxurious without being over powering. I received this product in exchange for my honest review from Influenster and Clinique.

I am so happy to tell you that I have seen excellent results using this magical elixir, brighter and smoother skin. First, it is absorbed super quickly, a product without odor and they are the best. Mainly it gives me an amazing lifting look! It became my favorite in my daily skincare routine. Its packaging is so cute, but also perfect for keeping the product in optimal conditions as it is made of glass.
I absolutely love the texture of this cream! It didn't feel sticky, glided on smoothly, and provided my skin with ample hydration overnight. I would recommend!

The packaging was very nice and I love Clinique for the clean ingredients and the effectiveness of their skincare. Clinique is always a great brand to chose from. Applying the cream at night I felt it had a great texture and my skin felt refreshed. I also noticed a very light scent which I like. I don't like any strong smells. I definitely recommend this cream and mask combination. My skin felt great after.

Let me just say that this product gives, luxury expensive and has everything you need in a night cream. It's so rich to the touch it's creamy it's lushy it gives you that feel of this is going to help my skin and it does. I have noticed a tremendous change in my face especially around my eye area and my forehead I cannot express how much you need this

I like the packaging in the glass jar with a purple color. The texture is thicker than body lotion, making it easy to apply on my face without feeling greasy. It works well for hydration, and my skin looks smooth after just a few days of use. The only one point left is that it has a strong smell.

I love the deep purple bottle! It is such a beautiful color and elegant choice for the package. I opened it and didn't really smell much of anything that bothered me since it is not scented but there is something of a light smell in there. I thought it was a good thickness in texture and not to heavy or oily. It does feel a little tacky at first but it absorbs really well after a while and makes my skin look nice and feels hydrated. I try to use a good amount since it is a mask but not so much that it just feels like it's sitting on my face and I want it to last so you really don't need a ton and just have to explore how much is right for your skin. I love how my skin looks in the morning and it gives off a smooth feeling and looks like it's glowing so there is a difference. If used consistently or at least in a routine every once in a while i really do think it helps fine lines and believe I noticed a small difference on my forehead. I absolutely enjoyed this overnight cream for it is quick and easy option for before bed and works well. I overall liked it. I received this free in exchange for an honest review.

avis.titre: Very thick and emollient, slightly sticky
avis.texte: This is a very thick and emollient cream, great if you like a heavier cream at night. It is a little sticky and I can see why it can also be considered a mask. Personally it's little too heavy for me in summertime but it will be great in the drier months. I received this product for free for my review.

I used it for a month to see how it goes and I seriously saw a change in my skin considering that it leaves your skin with a soft but not greasy texture, it doesn't have much fragrance, just what is necessary, it comes in a glass container I am 28 years old But I'm trying to take care of my skin from now on and I won't hesitate to include it in my routine from now on, it has good effectiveness.

This face cream is definitely better than a lot of the others I've tried in the past. A little goes a long way and it's absorbed by the skin nicely without feeling greasy or sticky. The packaging is very pleasant and eye catching so you know what you're looking for, and the fragrance is very light.

I have been using this cream for a week. And I'm really liking it. The cream looks thick but very soft and smooth on the skin, it absorbed right into the skin. It doesn't really have a scent so it's perfect. And my skin is very soft in the morning.

I have been using this night cream a few nights a week and it has made a noticeable difference in my skin's plumpness and hydration. I'm 45 and getting a little sagging and loss of firmness. This cream is substantial and a little heavy, which I like in a night cream. It is unscented, like all Clinique products.

avis.titre: A rich cream that leaves my skin feeling soft and supple
avis.texte: I live in an extremely dry climate, and this summer has been especially harsh on my skin. This Clinique smart clinical repair cream has been a great help in keeping my skin feeling soft, supple, and hydrated. I've been using it at night as well as in the morning. It has a very light scent that doesn't conflict with my perfume. Though it is a very rich cream, it doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. It hasn't caused any breakouts.

avis.titre: Everything my skin needs in one product
avis.texte: I am super satisfied with this sleeping mask! It hydrates my skin immediately, feels cooling, absorbs easily and I wake up with a beautiful glow the next morning.

I like that this product is in a glass jar. I was skeptical at first, my skin can be sensitive. The first evening I felt like it was tacky and didn't do much for me, but I kept using it and I'm pretty pleasantly surprised! My skin looks good in the morning, I've figured out the right amount to use so it's not over sticky/tacky feeling. I don't like the smell, it smells like glue lol. But it definitely seems to make my skin look even / smoother. I think with continued use I'd add this to my collection. I would recommend trying it!

I've been using the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Overnight Cream for a month. The texture is thick and feels like a gentle lotion. A little bit goes a long way! The ingredients are gentle, and it absorbs nice. I was excited to find this it helps reduce my eye wrinkles, and it doesn't have a scent, so it's great for sensitive skin.

I was very excited to be given this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I used it for about a week prior to writing this review. I felt as though it went on very easy and sat well on my skin. I didn't love the smell though, smelled very artificial. The packaging was gorgeous with a striking purple color. I noticed some benefits in the one week I used it but am looking forward to seeing more of an effect with longer term use.

However, I've noticed that I tend to wake up with an oilier T-zone than usual, so I've started using it sparingly in those areas to prevent excess oil and potential breakouts. Despite having sensitive skin, I haven't experienced any irritation with this product, which is a positive. The scent is very light and clean, almost undetectable, which is something I appreciate. Overall, while it doesn't stand out compared to some of my other overnight creams, I could see this being useful during the winter or for those with particularly dry skin. It's a solid option, but it hasn't quite earned a spot as a favorite in my routine.

I love this face cream! Very light and non irritating. I am using it on my face and neck , it absorbs quickly. I am hopeful that it reduces the crepey look on my neck. It seems to have already helped and I assume that will continue.

From the first application, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin's texture and hydration. By morning, my skin felt incredibly soft, plump, and radiant. The cream's rich yet non-greasy formula absorbs quickly, providing deep nourishment throughout the night. I've struggled with fine lines and uneven skin tone, but this overnight recovery mask has made a visible difference. My complexion looks more even, and my skin feels firmer and rejuvenated. Another major plus is that it didn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. It's perfect for anyone looking for a powerful, effective overnight treatment that delivers real results. I highly recommend the Smart Clinical Repair Overnight Recovery Cream + Mask to anyone seeking to elevate their skincare regimen. Five stars all the way!
This cream is the best. It has no scent at all. A great creamy texture that absorbs in no time. I love how it leaves my skin looking plump and ready to face the day.

avis.titre: Deeply moisturizing and nourishing even for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I am an avid collector of different moisturizers and masks. Now that that is out of the way, I've tried a lot. I currently use tretinoin in my skin care routine so I'm especially always looking for a more hydrating, gentle moisturizer for my skin. I've actually never tried a moisturizer from Clinique before so this was a very welcome package to see! For starters, there is no discernible scent to this moisturizer. It is a light beige color and thicker than gel type moisturizer but not exceedingly thick like those usually labeled as "cream". In short, it felt really great to apply and feel on my skin afterwards. My skin stays a little tacky after but not noticeably so (only if I'm touching my skin) and it does not feel greasy at all. It is very comfortable to wear at night, even after all the other things I apply as part of my routine. My skin hasn't felt dry at all while using this product (even with the tret!) and I didn't notice any sort of negative reaction. I don't usually have sensitive skin but my use of retinol has made it a little reactive lately—I was very pleased to see I had no issue with this. I love that there's peptides in it! I'm very pleased with this, I've used it as both a standalone product and as a mask over a lighter moisturizer. It has worked great both ways!
This cream doesn't really have much of a scent, however the texture is nice. My skin seemed to absorb it well, and it seems to work nicely. The glass container is a nice touch.

avis.auteur: Get it! You will see results within week

The packaging looks very sleek and modern. Love it. It might be a little bit more money than you would spend at your drug store but it really lasts a very long time, a little goes a long way, and it is visibly working for me & I love it.
